title: Wings
description:
One of humanity’s greatest passions has always been to fly.
All it takes is a pair of wings, right? (And in our case, an enormous engine.) 
Birds — dwellers of the treetops — inhabitants of lakes — the tireless recyclers of the city’s food. 
A documentation of the urban winged scene. 
Fasten your seatbelts; the captain wishes you a pleasant flight..
